get_current_time: get the current timestamp, datetime string, and weekday from the SystemApp time manager
wait_for_notification: wait for the next notification or user message with a configurable timeout in seconds
wait: advance the simulation time by a given number of seconds when idle
get_wait_for_notification_timeout: check if the current wait for notification timeout has expired and return it
reset_wait_for_notification_timeout: reset and clear the current wait for notification timeout state
